# netbox_scripts (Data Source)

Lists NetBox script objects (`/api/extras/scripts/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_scripts" "all" {}

data "netbox_scripts" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "scripts_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_scripts.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/scripts/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `is_executable` (Boolean) Is Executable.
- `module` (Number) Module.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `vars` (String) Vars.
